# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the EXACT tasks you broke/fixed) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — generalize-to-hidden-copies + type-fidelity + scope/verify contract (4 additive prompt edits)
- Changes I made (file + cluster):
  - task_template.md "how this is graded" block (cluster 1: fails on hidden copies 2/3): final code re-runs on 3 differing copies; forbid baking in copy-1 specifics; **explicit early step to inspect ALL THREE input copies** (the proven behavior of passing trace 58109) + derive data extent dynamically.
  - task_template.md type paragraph (cluster 2: TYPE mismatch, 50630/450-9): grader compares value AND type; keep extracted text as text; don't parse fragments into datetime/number unless asked; blank≠0.
  - task_template.md scope paragraph (cluster 3: over-production/over-engineering, CF_11072/325-44/3911): fill only requested cells; no fabricated labels/summaries; formatting tasks keep values/formulas; simplest reading; don't overwrite a correct answer with a more elaborate one absent a concrete error.
  - task_template.md verification step 3 (cluster 4, 53367): print value AND python type per answer cell; confirm intended value+type. prompt.md: 2 persistent one-liners reinforcing generalize-from-data + value/type match.
- Expected effect + why safe: targets the dominant pass-1-fail-2/3 cluster and the type/over-production clusters. All edits ADDITIVE (knowledge/contract) or a stronger verification step; answer_position is fixed across copies (confirmed in scorer) so nothing changes where passing tasks write. Passing tasks already compute from data, emit correct types, fill only requested cells, and verify — no trajectory change expected.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none exist (iteration 1). Used MEMORY.md to AVOID known regression traps.
- Refuted hypotheses NOT re-tried (from memory of a prior rejected run): (1) banning/​hardening against live formulas — LibreOffice recalcs them at grading; (2) any blanket whitespace-strip — GT preserves source spacing on pass-through cells; (3) boolean→literal / formula-block restructure. I deliberately did NOT mandate data_only=True in verification nor flag "="-strings, because a freshly-written live formula reads None in-session and would scare the agent off formulas that recalc fine.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: 110-2 (ambiguous AutoFilter-intersection semantics, filled 9/39) and 325-44's undocumented combo-selection — both underdetermined from the instruction; no safe general rule found. 53367 semantic formula fix + degenerate loop left to structural verify only (behavioral, prose won't fix).
- Plateau signal: n/a (first iteration). If this is accepted but small, next lever to try: worked-example exemplars for the extract-and-type-match pattern, or sharpening the "inspect all 3 copies" step into a mandatory numbered precondition.
- Focus next iteration: re-diagnose which of the 4 clusters actually moved; if type/generalization moved but over-production didn't, add a concrete worked example for formatting-only tasks.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.520 Δ=+0.000 · fixed={50051, 59259, CF_11072} · broke={56975, 59667, 73-45}. — its WHOLE batch was reverted; re-introduce only the edits that did NOT break a task above, dropping/redesigning the ones that did.
<!-- cand_0001: rejected val=0.520 Δ=+0.000 -->

## Iteration cand_0002 — re-ship cand_0001's SAFE edits, drop its 3 breakers, add pre-filled-example-cell rule + example-anchored type contract
- Changes I made (file + cluster):
  - prompt.md (Cluster 3, hidden-copy generalization): "re-run on other copies → compute extent/boundaries/thresholds from data; never hardcode row count/position/boundary/year seen only in preview." (cand_0001 block A — it FIXED 50051 with no break.)
  - prompt.md (Cluster 2, NEW — the highest-leverage clean rule cand_0001 lacked): pre-filled worked-example / summary / spilled-UNIQUE cells reflect copy 1 only → use them for FORMAT, recompute every value from raw source. Targets 3911 + 38332 (both HAD the correct computation, then abandoned it to defer to a copy-1 counts table / spill cell).
  - task_template.md "how your answer is graded" (Cluster 3 contract): re-run on 3 copies, value AND type compared, write verbatim paths, may inspect all copies early. (cand_0001 block C, no break.)
  - task_template.md type/format paragraph (Cluster 4): replicate the worked-example cell's exact per-column type/format + preserve spaces; instruction-named literals (#N/A, "-"); PRESERVE rich-text/formatting, never flatten. Targets 50630, 57232, 59259; explicitly protects 73-45.
  - task_template.md scope + verify (Cluster 5): fill only requested cells; formatting/CF tasks keep values+formulas (cand_0001 block E1/E2, FIXED CF_11072); step-3 verify prints value+type, confirms coverage + no unintended None, special types kept.
- Expected effect + why safe: expected fixes 50051, 59259, CF_11072 (cand_0001's proven fixes, re-shipped without the breakers), plus NEW 3911, 38332 (Cluster-2 rule), plus 50630, 57232 (example/instruction-anchored type). All edits BOUNDED-additive; the 26 passing tasks already compute from source, match types, preserve formatting, and fill only the requested range — no trajectory flips.
- Building on prior RESULTS: cand_0001 (REJECTED, net-zero) fixed {50051,59259,CF_11072}, broke {56975,59667,73-45}. Subagent + my own trace reads isolated the breakers to: block F "text must be str" and block D "keep text as text" (flattened rich text → 73-45), and block E clauses 3–4 "simplest reading / don't elaborate during verification" (→ 59667, 56975). I RE-SHIP only blocks A, C, E1, E2 (fixers, no break) and DROP F, D-text-clause, E3-4, and the blanket "leave blank vs 0" (replaced by narrower instruction-named-literal rule).
- Refuted hypotheses NOT re-tried: (from cand_0001 RESULT) do NOT tell the agent "a text answer must be a str" or "keep extracted text as text" — flattens CellRichText and breaks 73-45. Do NOT add "take the simplest reading / don't replace with a more elaborate computation" — breaks 59667/56975 which need a non-obvious computation. (from MEMORY) no blanket whitespace strip; no no-XML ban; no formula/boolean restructure; formulas recalc via LibreOffice so don't ban them.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: Cluster 1 VALUE/logic ceiling (~9-13 tasks: 53367, 5192, 56996, 57090, 59743, 11842, 325-44, 450-9, 110-2 filter-AND-vs-OR, 39046 ambiguity, 55931 row-alignment) — genuine computation/reshape/macro errors; no general prose rule encodes task-specific logic without leaking answers. Designs already implied unsafe: task-specific hints = overfit.
- Plateau signal: only 1 prior RESULT (rejected net-zero). This iteration switches lever from cand_0001's broad type/blank emphasis (which regressed) to (a) isolating+re-shipping only proven-safe blocks and (b) a single NEW knowledge rule (pre-filled example cells) + observable-anchored type contract. If this is still flat, next lever: a worked few-shot <example> for the type/format-matching pattern, or accept Cluster 1 is a capability ceiling unreachable by prose.
- Focus next iteration: re-diagnose which of {50051,59259,CF_11072,3911,38332,50630,57232} actually moved; if the pre-filled-example rule (Cluster 2) landed but type (Cluster 4) didn't, add one concrete <example> showing example-row type replication; do NOT reopen Cluster 1.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.580 Δ=+0.060 · fixed={110-2, 38332, 50051, CF_11072} · broke={73-45}.
